quality_assessment: Page covers core backreference functionality accurately but missing important context about engine behavior, error handling, and performance trade-offs that would help users understand when and how to use backreferences effectively

issues.description: Missing explanation that backreferences are ONLY available with PCRE2 and NOT supported by default regex engine
issues.current_content: Backreferences allow you to match previously captured groups. **Requires PCRE2** (`-P` flag).
issues.should_include: Explicit statement that default regex engine does NOT support backreferences. Users need to understand this is a PCRE2-exclusive feature and why.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a note explaining that the default regex-automata engine uses finite automata which cannot support backreferences, while PCRE2 uses backtracking which enables backreferences at a performance cost

issues.description: Performance section is too brief and lacks important context about PCRE2 vs default engine performance characteristics
issues.current_content: Backreferences prevent some regex optimizations, which can make searches slower. Use them only when necessary.
issues.should_include: Detailed explanation of: (1) PCRE2 uses backtracking vs finite automata, (2) potential for exponential complexity on pathological patterns, (3) default engine guarantees linear time complexity, (4) backreferences specifically prevent automata-based optimizations
issues.fix_suggestion: Expand performance section with concrete examples of performance implications. Reference docs/advanced-patterns/performance.md:25-52 for details on PCRE2 backtracking behavior and pathological patterns

issues.description: No mention of how ripgrep helps users when they attempt backreferences without -P flag
issues.should_include: Information about automatic error detection and suggestion to use --pcre2 when backreferences are detected in pattern
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a troubleshooting section or admonition explaining that if users try backreferences without -P, ripgrep will detect 'backreferences' in the error and suggest using --pcre2

issues.description: Missing mention of --engine auto option that can automatically detect backreference patterns
issues.should_include: Information about --engine auto option that automatically selects PCRE2 when pattern features like backreferences are detected
issues.fix_suggestion: Add note that users can use --engine auto to let ripgrep automatically select PCRE2 when pattern contains backreferences, avoiding need to remember -P flag

issues.description: Missing important syntax details about replacement group naming rules and disambiguation
issues.current_content: Basic examples shown but no mention of syntax rules
issues.should_include: Syntax constraints: group names must be [_0-9A-Za-z], longest match rule applies ($1a matches group '1a'), use ${1}a for disambiguation, invalid references replaced with empty strings
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a subsection under 'Backreferences in Replacements' explaining naming constraints and disambiguation syntax with examples like ${1}a vs $1a

issues.description: No mention of PCRE2 JIT compilation for improved performance
issues.should_include: When PCRE2 JIT is available, backreference patterns can be 2-10x faster (though still typically slower than default engine)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add note about PCRE2 JIT compilation benefits when available, referencing docs/advanced-patterns/pcre2.md:122
